# Common-English word list, used ONLY to DEMOTE (never drop) a term during
# recall-query shaping - see `lib/content.py::_selectivity_score`.
#
# WHY THIS EXISTS
# Postgres document frequency cannot separate contentless English from domain
# identifiers: measured on the live `overlord` bank (135,565 units),
# `particularly` = 0.022 pct df and `situation` = 0.018 pct df, while `npm` =
# 1.38 pct and `worktree` = 1.85 pct. Both classes are rare, so a df-based rule
# ranks the filler ABOVE the identifier. English-word membership does separate
# them: of 43 contentless words, 43 are in this list; of 23 domain identifiers
# (`pkce` `nginx` `zod` `jwt` `tmux` `coolify` `webkite` `tls` `bm25` ...),
# 20 are not. The three that are - `hindsight` `deploy` `container` - are
# genuine English words, which is why membership only ever costs a term
# ranking weight and never removes it from the query.
#
# HOW IT WAS DERIVED (reproducible)
#   1. All `type=="user"` messages from every agent transcript under
#      ~/.switchroom/agents/*/.claude/projects/*/*.jsonl, with channel
#      envelopes, <system-reminder> blocks and memory tags stripped by this
#      package's own strip_channel_envelope / strip_memory_tags.
#      => 15,094 real user turns, 65,984 distinct tokens.
#   2. Keep tokens appearing in >= 2 distinct turns (drops typos / one-off ids).
#   3. Intersect with the system English dictionary, lowercase alphabetic only,
#      length >= 4 (shorter words are either already in BM25_STOPWORDS or
#      collide with identifiers such as `npm`, `jwt`, `ci`, `pr`).
#   => 10762 words.
#
# The length >= 4 floor and the "demote, never drop" rule are what keep this
# safe: a query genuinely ABOUT `configuration` still sends `configuration`
# whenever nothing more selective competes for the slot.
#
# SOURCE / ATTRIBUTION
# Membership was filtered against the SCOWL-derived `american-english` word
# list (package `wamerican`), Copyright 2000-2018 Kevin Atkinson, used under
# its permissive license, which allows use and modification provided the
# copyright notice appears in supporting documentation. Only the intersection
# with the corpus above is redistributed here.
